digest.component_or_area: LLM gate infrastructure (plan-review, code-review, completion-verification gates and cost analysis)
propositions: Measured mean cost 11.85 dollars per completed ticket across three LLM gates (plan-review 3.02, code-review 1.42, completion-verifier 2.24 per run) post-Bedrock switch.

Cheap-model experiments rejected Haiku for agentic review (50-57% recall) and rejected Nova Pro for completion verification (3 false-accepts); Sonnet retained for completion verification with 22/22 gold-set parity.

Code-review severity axes are structurally inert because the blocking decision reads only the security criterion (1 of 3,363 findings) and the 0.95 impact threshold is unreachable with observed ordinal axis values (median gap 0.65, only 7 of 432 combinations reach 0.95).
Overlap drain has never surfaced a finding (0 of 2,093 plan reviews) despite ~$165 per 5-day cost and recommended kill switch pending redesign.

Two false-positive alarm firings (23:07Z) caused by over-broad grep patterns in observability.sh matching LLM output prose, not real errors; both new defects filed (widespread-zealous-narwhal, colossal-slothful-grouse).

Deprecation registry is complete; only the .gitattributes migration arm (Tier 1) is eligible for immediate removal; single-pass review surfaces and REBAR_LLM_MODEL are candidates for the next pre-1.0 breaking window but do not meet v0.12.0 removal criteria.
